source_text: Theorem on formal functions and Grothendieck's Existence Theorem

<STRUCT_0001>
These papers give generalizations of the theorem on formal functions
<REF_0001> (sometimes referred to Grothendieck's Fundamental
Theorem for proper morphisms) and Grothendieck's Existence
Theorem <REF_0002>.
<STRUCT_0002>
<STRUCT_0003> Knutson: <EMPHOPEN_0001>Algebraic spaces<EMPHCLOSE_0001> <REF_0003>
<STRUCT_0004>
Generalizes these theorems to algebraic spaces.
<STRUCT_0005>
<STRUCT_0006> Abramovich-Vistoli: <EMPHOPEN_0002>Compactifying the space of stable maps<EMPHCLOSE_0002>
<REF_0004>
<STRUCT_0007>
Generalizes these theorems to tame Deligne-Mumford stacks
<STRUCT_0008>
<STRUCT_0009> Olsson and Starr: <EMPHOPEN_0003>Quot functors for Deligne-Mumford stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0003>
<REF_0005>
<STRUCT_0010>
Generalizes these theorems to separated Deligne-Mumford stacks.
<STRUCT_0011>
<STRUCT_0012> Olsson: <EMPHOPEN_0004>On proper coverings of Artin stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0004>
<REF_0006>
<STRUCT_0013>
Provides a generalization to proper Artin stacks.
<STRUCT_0014>
<STRUCT_0015> Conrad: <EMPHOPEN_0005>Formal GAGA on Artin stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0005> <REF_0007>
<STRUCT_0016>
Provides a generalization to proper Artin stacks and proves a formal
GAGA theorem.
<STRUCT_0017>
<STRUCT_0018> Olsson: <EMPHOPEN_0006>Sheaves on Artin stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0006> <REF_0008>
<STRUCT_0019>
Provides another proof for the generalization to proper Artin stacks.
<STRUCT_0020>
